description: Revert to the stable 8-layer depth configuration (which previously achieved ~0.988 val_bpb) and increase the Matrix Learning Rate from 0.055 to 0.065 to accelerate convergence and potentially push performance below the current best of 0.9879, given that the 9-layer attempt resulted in a significant performance drop (1.0379) likely due to insufficient training time for the added capacity.
